title: Worker boundary — trust model and setuid helper removal
summary: The unused setuid helper namtor-worker-spawn has been removed. The worker runs as the namtor user (same as the daemon) and self-applies seccomp + landlock. The sandbox is the privilege boundary, not a UID drop.

worker_trust_model.privilege_boundary: seccomp + landlock (self-applied by worker after model load)
worker_trust_model.spawn_method: ChildSupervisor::spawn in namtor-daemon/src/supervisor.rs spawns namtor-worker directly via std::process::Command
worker_trust_model.sandbox_application: worker calls sandbox::apply_sandbox() (landlock then seccomp) before the request loop when --apply-sandbox is passed

landlock_restrictions.filesystem: all paths denied (no allow rules) — AccessFs::from_all(ABI::V6) with no permitted paths
landlock_restrictions.network: all bind/connect denied via AccessNet::from_all(ABI::V6) where kernel supports it; seccomp socket/connect/bind is the fallback

package_scan.setuid_files_in_manifest: none — install-manifest.toml has no mode 4755 entries
package_scan.setuid_files_in_binary_list: none — verify-reproducible.sh and sign-packages.sh no longer list namtor-worker-spawn
package_scan.arch_post_install: chmod u+s on namtor-worker-spawn removed from packaging/arch/namtor.install

verification.cargo_test_escape: 9 passed; 0 failed (including 3 new: denied_open_templates, denied_open_keys, denied_open_models)
verification.lsp_diagnostics: no errors on all changed source files
